clips.title: The story
paras: Zengu in Hammerfall wants the sigils that guard Trol'kalar, the sword of Lord Ignaeus Trollbane. The first, the Sigil of Strom, was taken by the Syndicate, and a Syndicate agent in Stromgarde is likely to hold it.

In ancient times the trolls fought the Arathorian Empire, and their ablest foe was Lord Ignaeus of Strom, called Trollbane. He went into battle wielding Trol'kalar, a name that means troll slayer in the trolls' old tongue. Now Trollbane's sons are weakened and their stronghold lies in ruins.

Several sigils protect the sword, and the survivors of Stromgarde each took a share of them. Zengu says they must all be retrieved. The Syndicate seized the first, and Zengu reckons one of their agents in Stromgarde has it. Bring it back to him at Hammerfall.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: In ancient times, trolls fought against the Arathorian Empire and our most capable adversary, Lord Ignaeus of Strom, named Trollbane. He rode into battle wielding Trol'kalar--troll slayer, in their ancient tongue.
But now the sons of Trollbane are weakened, their stronghold brought to ruin.
The sword is protected by several sigils that were divided among the survivors of Stromgarde, and we must retrieve them.
The first was taken by the Syndicate, one of their men in Stromgarde should have it.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you located the first sigil yet? It is most likely carried on the person of one of the Syndicate agents in Stromgarde.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent, mon. That's a good start to collecting the sigils we'll need to remove Trol'kalar from Trollbane's tomb.
